title: Pilot Project Renal and Cardiovascular Tertiary Prevention in Preeclampsia
official: Pilotprojekt Renale Und kardiovaskuläre Tertiärprävention Nach Präeklampsie
summary: Tertiary prevention program for women with preeclampsia, HELLP syndrome, kidney disease and pregnancy or associated conditions, including founding of a biobank. (Observational study since no interference with regular path of treatment suggested in national and international guidelines)
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* older than 18 yrs
* diagnosed preeclampsia, HELLP syndrome or kidney disease durig pregnancy

Exclusion Criteria:

* unable for informed consent
